chunks: Through which God will lead those who follow His pleasure to the path of peace, and guide them out of darkness into light by His will, and to the path that is straight.
ai.seo_question: How does God guide those who seek His pleasure according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is frequently cited to illustrate the mechanism of divine guidance through the Prophet and the Imams, who serve as the tangible means ('bihi') through which Allah leads the faithful. It emphasizes that true salvation involves not only intellectual illumination from darkness to light but also practical adherence to the 'paths of peace' (sull al-salam), which are often interpreted as the teachings and conduct of the Ahl al-Bayt. This triad of guidance—seeking pleasure, emerging from darkness, and following the straight path—underscores the holistic nature of Tawhid in action.
